tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand navy. The logo ground, the header, the footer and full-bleed dark sections. Gold and white sit on it.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Brand gold. The logo on navy, the primary button fill (navy text on it, 12.7:1), small marks on navy. Never text on paper or white (1.4:1).

tokens.name: navy-raised
tokens.usage: Hover and raised surfaces inside navy sections; secondary button hover on navy.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, form fields, panels on paper.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate section bands, so long pages read in blocks.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on paper, surface and surface-alt (16:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions, dates on paper, surface and surface-alt (6.6:1 or more).

tokens.name: gold-text
tokens.usage: Gold as TEXT: eyebrows, ticks, small accents on paper, surface and surface-alt (4.8:1 or more). Light theme only uses this darker gold.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text on navy and navy-raised (18:1).

tokens.name: on-navy-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on navy (9:1).

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a gold fill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules between list rows and sections, card borders. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Form field and secondary button borders (3:1 or more on paper and surface).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Form error text and field border, always with a written message.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Monthly management reports, unaudited financial statements and XBRL.
styles.usage: The one paragraph under an H1.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We match bank accounts, cards and cash as the information comes through.
styles.usage: All running copy. Keep lines under 68 characters.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows above section headings, uppercase. gold-text on paper, gold on navy.

spacing.note: Harvey's scale: each step doubles. Values are the desktop size (1025px and wider). Under 1025px multiply by 0.875; at 1445px by 1.125; at 1730px by 1.25.

tokens.name: space-unit
tokens.usage: Base unit. Icon gaps, pill padding.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value; inside buttons vertically.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; gap between list items; page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between a heading and its content; page side gutter from 1025px.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside one section.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of every section.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Hero top padding; space before the footer.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, small pills, form fields.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large media and the split call-to-action band.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Fixed site header.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Outer page width; full-bleed bands stop here.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Text-and-card content width.

tokens.name: post-max
tokens.usage: Article column.
